<function name="SetDamageBonus" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the bonus damage. Bonus damage isn't automatically applied, so this will have no outer effect by default.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="damage" type="number">The extra damage to be added.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
